source_row.statement: Crew, BrainStorm, Review and Chat Room share one participant/run/message/artifact/Usage/recovery/composer-target foundation.

rows.verified_scope: New examples reuse existing collaboration runs, participants, messages and artifacts.
rows.remaining_scope: No durable provider/Usage/recovery implementation is supplied.

source_row.statement: Every invocation opens a configuration modal populated from Settings defaults.

rows.verified_scope: Every explicit sample run and Replay opens configuration; Run another Crew requires confirmation.
rows.remaining_scope: All four workflow invocation routes are not recertified.

source_row.statement: No selected model or Persona is silently substituted.

rows.verified_scope: Unresolved model selection leaves configuration open and creates no run; cancel shared model picker leaves main route unchanged.
rows.remaining_scope: General unavailable-account, Skill and provider fallback coverage remains open.

source_row.statement: Each workflow produces a transcript card, expandable recent detail, full panel and Activity domain.

rows.verified_scope: Typed Crew card, stable assignment/result editor tab, correct Activity count and bounded hover.
rows.remaining_scope: Whole expanded legacy Crew card layout is not reworked here.

source_row.statement: Each participant is clickable to open the exact participant transcript and evidence.

rows.verified_scope: Activity member click opens the real participant transcript.
rows.remaining_scope: Every other workflow/participant layout remains separately tracked.

source_row.statement: Pause/resume/cancel preserve truthful state, transcript and artifacts.

rows.verified_scope: Pause prevents delivery, Resume finishes same run, old-epoch payload stays rejected, Cancel/Reset stop stale callbacks; completed output retained on Replay.
rows.remaining_scope: No restart persistence or process-crash recovery is proved.

source_row.statement: Permissions are bounded by the parent ceiling and participants cannot self-authorize.

rows.verified_scope: Changed parent mode/permission/worktree refuses current local work; Auto cannot override explicit single-agent request.
rows.remaining_scope: No native permission service or elevation grants are exercised.

source_row.statement: Crew config includes coordinator, roles, models, Personas, context, tools, permissions, dependencies, expected outputs, parallelism, synthesis and limits.

rows.verified_scope: Shared model/Persona roster; explicit expected outputs, frozen context, dependencies, requested/effective parallelism in the three-role local work contract.
rows.remaining_scope: Arbitrary Crew rosters/coordinators, optional specialists, live tools/Skills and provider routing/limits are not proved.

source_row.statement: Crew executes delegated work rather than functioning as a discussion-only Chat Room.

rows.verified_scope: Two independent local calculations feed dependent CSV assembly; verified structured outputs precede completion.
rows.remaining_scope: Local calculation is not live multi-agent or native project execution.

source_row.statement: Crew Auto is a checkable Multi-Agent submenu item.

rows.verified_scope: The existing checkable Multi-Agent Crew Auto control is retained and uses the same enabled/configured state.
rows.remaining_scope: This capture enters through Demo Studio; not all product entry routes are recorded.

source_row.statement: Enabling Crew Auto opens its configuration modal before the check becomes active.

rows.verified_scope: Mandatory configuration, cancellation no-op, enabled flag only after successful policy commit.
rows.remaining_scope: Policy is in-memory concept state; actual project Settings transaction and reload are not proved.

source_row.statement: Crew Auto criteria cannot widen authority or override an explicit single-agent selection.

rows.verified_scope: Low-complexity and explicit-single requests create no Crew/card/Usage. Member/concurrency and parent-context counterexamples refuse admission or result updates.
rows.remaining_scope: Input classification and ceilings are supplied typed fixture facts, not real orchestrator/permission enforcement.

source_row.statement: Build With Crew binds Crew to exact Plan version and To-Dos.

rows.remaining_scope: Build With Crew exact Plan/ToDo atomic binding is outside this batch; no partial acceptance is inferred.

source_row.statement: Crew participant rows open individual transcripts.

rows.verified_scope: Real Crew hover selection opens pinned Activity with three member rows; a row opens its actual participant transcript.
rows.remaining_scope: All roster variants and inherited legacy Crew paths are outside scope.

source_row.statement: Opening or editing any Crew, Crew Auto, BrainStorm, Review, Chat Room, BSD workflow, or Build-With-Crew modal creates only local WorkflowLaunchDraft state.
acceptance_criteria: No durable run/session/provider effect before confirmation.
negative_constraints: Do not create placeholder cards on modal open.

rows.verified_scope: Opening/editing Crew configuration leaves run/effect counters unchanged.
rows.remaining_scope: Generic launch-draft schema and other workflows are not newly certified.

source_row.statement: Before confirmed Start/Apply, there is no provider request, participant session, Usage record, durable start event, workflow artifact, project mutation, or permission grant.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation proves zero side effects on cancel.
negative_constraints: Do not treat capability preview as execution.

rows.verified_scope: Before confirmation no Crew run/card/provider/Usage effect; Auto policy commit alone creates no run.
rows.remaining_scope: No real provider/session/permission backend exists in this HTML proof.

source_row.statement: Cancel/close discards the launch draft and creates no domain event; unsent source text/config remains available where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Closing a modal is a local view action.
negative_constraints: Do not mint a domain cancel command for a run that does not exist.

rows.verified_scope: Cancel starts nothing and exposes Configure again.
rows.remaining_scope: All held-message/source-request cases remain outside this batch.

source_row.statement: Failed Start retains modal values, shows typed failure, and creates no fake card or partial participant records.
acceptance_criteria: Retry can reuse the launch draft after currentness refresh.
negative_constraints: Do not clear user configuration on dispatch failure.

rows.verified_scope: Malformed capacity, count, parallelism and unavailable model keep modal values and create no partial run.
rows.remaining_scope: Full provider/backend Start-error surface is not exercised.

source_row.statement: Crew Auto becomes checked only after configuration confirmation and successful project Settings commit; cancel preserves the prior enabled state.
acceptance_criteria: The menu check reflects effective stored state.
negative_constraints: Do not optimistically enable before commit.

rows.verified_scope: Cancel leaves Auto disabled, successful explicit commit enables; disabling preserves template and prevents new admission.
rows.remaining_scope: Successful durable project Settings write is not established by the local settingsWrites counter.

source_row.statement: Repeated Start with the same command/idempotency binding returns the original run; same key with changed config is rejected.
negative_constraints: Do not deduplicate only by modal instance ID.

rows.verified_scope: Same request returns original run; changed configuration or different Auto facts with same key are rejected.
rows.remaining_scope: Concept-level request identity, not native exactly-once dispatch or durable replay.

source_row.statement: Retries create new attempt identities for the same slot; replacement creates a new assignment revision; old late results cannot count.
negative_constraints: Do not overwrite failed attempt evidence.

rows.verified_scope: Changed/retried participant attempt invalidates an old result and dependent completion.
rows.remaining_scope: Full UI retry/replacement recovery demo is not part of the two recordings.

source_row.statement: Crew clean completion requires every required expected output to exist or be explicitly waived with reason.
negative_constraints: Do not mark Crew complete from participant status alone.

rows.verified_scope: All three structured required outputs must validate before CSV artifact and clean completion; note/tool-success cannot bypass.
rows.remaining_scope: Explicit waiver and arbitrary expected-output contracts remain unproved.

source_row.statement: A collaborative run completes only when its kind-specific completion predicate, required participant dispositions, output/artifact finalization, and pending user decision state are resolved.
negative_constraints: Do not use last message as lifecycle truth.

rows.verified_scope: Finalization checks verified outputs/current participant attempts; repeated finalization reuses one artifact.
rows.remaining_scope: Other kind-specific completion predicates and durable decisions remain outside scope.

source_row.statement: Cancel fences every participant attempt and synthesis callback; later results may be retained as rejected/stale evidence but cannot alter the current run.
negative_constraints: Do not accept late high-quality output because it is useful.

rows.verified_scope: Canceled/reset run cannot accept later delivery; example playback cannot revive it.
rows.remaining_scope: Process crashes/provider transports are not exercised.

source_row.statement: A model unavailable before Start blocks or requires explicit replacement in the modal; it does not create a failed runtime participant merely from configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Availability is shown before commit where known.
negative_constraints: Do not claim a provider attempt occurred.

rows.verified_scope: Unavailable model before Start prevents admission and preserves configuration.
rows.remaining_scope: Provider capability adapters are not exercised.

source_row.requirement: Remove separate Open Activity buttons from every activity preview. Clicking the relevant preview item opens its corresponding detail/context, using existing canonical product routing where applicable.
source_row.acceptance: Every preview item resolves to the correct item/category; no inert rows or duplicate launch buttons.

rows.verified_scope: Crew preview item opens exact selected run in pinned Activity.
rows.remaining_scope: Other activity kinds are not all replayed in this batch.

source_row.requirement: All activity hover panels are bounded previews, with no internal scrolling. Show a deliberately limited useful subset; an overflow/count row may navigate to detail, but must not masquerade as the removed Open Activity button.
source_row.acceptance: All categories, large and empty lists, bottom and side viewport edges, wheel/trackpad behavior.

rows.verified_scope: Crew preview shows at most four run rows and no internal scrolling container.
rows.remaining_scope: All categories and maximum-density viewports remain open.

source_row.requirement: Provide multiple meaningful scenarios per feature, with a feature-to-demo coverage matrix. Distinct states or workflows count; changing only a title or replaying the same fixture does not.
source_row.acceptance: Inventory the actual feature denominator; map at least two scenarios per feature; verify observable outcomes, not only successful launch or toast.

rows.verified_scope: New delegation and Auto decision/outcome workflows have functional records plus matching recorded traces.
rows.remaining_scope: Global 551-row/67-group multiple-demo requirement remains OPEN; this is not two complete demos for every feature.

source_row.requirement: Record every in-scope demo and animation at 60 fps and inspect frame by frame. Distinguish encoded sampling rate, browser render cadence, dropped/duplicated frames, automated measurements, and actual visual inspection.
source_row.acceptance: Per-recording ID/hash, scenario, duration, frame count/PTS, timing measurements, frame-indexed review notes; no interpolation or repeated frames presented as native 60 fps.

rows.verified_scope: Two hash-bound 60-Hz acquired traces decoded in full and reviewed in consecutive indexed contact sheets with native keyframes.
rows.remaining_scope: All-feature campaign remains OPEN; recording cadence is separate from actual rendering and full-native-resolution every-frame inspection.

source_row.requirement: This is Plans/specification repair, not native implementation or readiness certification. Do not create WorkNodes/NodeSeeds/executable queues, close PNC-019, forge runtime evidence, or refresh protected generated governance merely to obtain green gates.
source_row.acceptance: Changed-file allowlist; gate results classified as introduced/existing/blocked; no unrelated lock/hash repinning.

rows.verified_scope: No canonical Plans, generated governance or readiness artifacts are modified.
rows.remaining_scope: Repository-wide gates and runtime readiness are not recertified.

source_row.requirement: All remaining collaboration configuration choice controls use the same anchored picker surface and interaction primitives as the main model picker, including non-model choice lists. Models and Personas reuse the actual main catalog/renderers and preserve destination isolation. Numeric/text inputs remain appropriate inputs, not fake model lists.
source_row.acceptance: Inventory every live field in Crew, Crew Auto, Chat Room, BrainStorm and Review; no leftover native select in these panels; test filtering, selected state, dismissal, placement and write destination.

rows.verified_scope: Crew and Auto retain shared model/Persona controls; new Auto criteria reuse existing option picker.
rows.remaining_scope: All collaboration picker combinations remain a separate denominator.
